through_line.name: le muscle arrecteur
through_line.progression: cache en bloc un (on ne voit que la chair de poule qui monte sur le bras, sans cause visible) -> revele en bloc deux (le badge s'ouvre : un ruban mint attache au bulbe du poil, qui se contracte et redresse le poil) -> compare en bloc trois (le meme ruban gonfle le pelage d'un animal a fourrure et emprisonne de l'air chaud) -> resolu en bloc quatre (le badge se declenche pour une emotion, exactement comme pour le froid)
through_line.resolution: le bloc final montre le meme circuit declenche par une emotion et non par le froid : le badge pulse en rose, le poil se dresse, la vague remonte le bras — le reflexe du hook trouve sa cause, et l'on comprend qu'il ne sert plus a rien chez l'humain

blocks.vo_line: Ta peau se hérisse devant une musique, alors que tu n'as pas froid. Le coupable est un muscle minuscule, planté au pied de chaque poil.
blocks.through_line_state: cache : la chair de poule monte sur le bras sans cause visible, le badge n'apparait qu'au dernier plan
shots: WIDE static: the person sits on the lavender sofa with headphones on, calm, then a shiver ripples up their shoulders and they hug their arms
CLOSE-UP static: their forearm; tiny rounded bumps rise across the skin one after another, three small sandy hairs standing straight up
MEDIUM low angle static: the person looks down at their own arm and raises one eyebrow, puzzled, then glances at the window
EXTREME CLOSE-UP slow push-in: one single bump on the skin, the small hair quivering upright, one baby blue sparkle popping beside it
MEDIUM static: the hair-and-muscle badge swings in from the right and settles beside the person with a bounce, two sparkles popping

blocks.vo_line: Ce petit muscle arrecteur se contracte et redresse le poil d'un coup sec. La peau se plisse autour de la racine : voilà la chair de poule.
blocks.through_line_state: revele : le ruban mint attache au bulbe se raccourcit, fait basculer le bulbe et redresse le poil, la peau se plisse autour
shots: WIDE static: the skin cutaway at rest; the three sandy hairs lie flat and sway gently, the mint ribbon-muscles slack
MEDIUM lateral gentle drift right: the first mint ribbon-muscle tightens and shortens sharply, tugging its lavender bulb sideways
CLOSE-UP high angle static: the sandy hair snaps upright as the bulb tilts, and the pink skin puckers into a rounded bump around its base
EXTREME CLOSE-UP slow push-in: the mint ribbon-muscle quivering under tension, a tiny baby blue sparkle popping at its anchor point
MEDIUM low angle static: all three hairs snap upright one after another and three rounded bumps rise in a row

blocks.vo_line: Chez un animal à fourrure, ce réflexe gonfle tout le pelage et emprisonne une couche d'air chaud. Toi, tu hérisses trois poils pour rien.
blocks.through_line_state: compare : le meme ruban souleve tout un pelage et cree une couche d'air chaud isolante, la ou l'humain ne dresse que trois poils inutiles
shots: WIDE static: the snowy clearing; the small sandy dog trots in from the left and stops, snowflakes drifting past it
MEDIUM static: the dog's whole coat puffs up at once, doubling its outline into a round fluffy ball, and it shakes once
EXTREME CLOSE-UP static: the puffed fur; the raised hairs trap little baby blue air pockets that glow faintly between them
CLOSE-UP low angle static: the dog sits contentedly in its puffed coat, blinking slowly, snow settling on its ears
MEDIUM static: beside the dog the hair-and-muscle badge pops in with only three lonely sandy hairs standing up and a tiny puff of air escaping between them

blocks.vo_line: Une émotion forte libère la même adrénaline que le grand froid, et le circuit se déclenche pareil : abonne-toi, demain on regarde le nez bouché.
blocks.through_line_state: resolu : le badge pulse en rose sous l'effet d'une emotion et non du froid, le poil se dresse et la vague remonte le bras — meme circuit, autre declencheur
shots: CLOSE-UP static: the person on the sofa with headphones, eyes closing as a warm rush passes over them, shoulders lifting
EXTREME CLOSE-UP static on the badge: a soft pink pulse travels up through the badge and the little hair springs upright
MEDIUM high angle static: bumps ripple up the person's forearm in a wave from wrist to elbow
MEDIUM static: the person opens their eyes, looks at their arm and grins, then rubs the arm once
CLOSE-UP low angle static: the person points at the viewer, a rounded sandy yellow bell shape pops in beside them and rings with two sparkles, and they wink
